value.summary: Titan's management demonstrates high credibility by consistently delivering on growth targets and margin bands despite extreme gold price volatility and geopolitical headwinds. They maintain transparency by calling out one-off gains from customs duty and inventory revaluations, ensuring investors can track normalized operational performance.

promises.quote: as far as our growth outlook is concerned, we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
promises.promised: Management guided for Eyewear division growth to close FY26 between 13% and 14%.
promises.actual_delivered: The division exceeded this, clocking 16% to 17% revenue growth as reported in the Q4 FY26 call.
promises.reasoning: The final growth rate of 16-17% surpassed the initial guidance of 13-14%.

promises.quote: by the time we end -- we come to YTD December, our growth rates should have become better than the first half growth rates.
promises.promised: Management promised that Jewellery growth rates by December (Q3) would improve over the first half of the year.
promises.actual_delivered: Jewellery growth reached 40% in Q3 FY26, significantly higher than the H1 trajectory, as noted in the Feb 2026 transcript.
promises.reasoning: The Q3 growth spike to 40% successfully pulled the YTD growth rate above the H1 levels.

promises.quote: gradually CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin. And I think they have reached -- they are maybe slightly earlier than what we expected
promises.promised: Management targeted a double-digit EBIT margin for CaratLane as it scaled.
promises.actual_delivered: By the end of FY26, CaratLane achieved an annual EBIT margin of nearly 10%, as confirmed in the May 2026 call.
promises.reasoning: The subsidiary reached the 10% threshold by the end of the fiscal year.

promises.quote: we've also moved from a loss in the previous year to a profit in the current quarter. And therefore, that transformational change in the margin also has a bearing on this consol figure.
promises.promised: Management aimed for the international jewellery business to move from losses to a secular profit trend.
promises.actual_delivered: The international business became profitable at the operating level for the full year FY26.
promises.reasoning: Management confirmed the business turned profitable on a full-year basis in the Q4 FY26 results.

promises.quote: accounting of that, you will see from 1st January, consolidation of Damas books into Titan consolidation will start from 1st January.
promises.promised: Management promised to begin consolidating Damas results into Titan's financials from January 1, 2026.
promises.actual_delivered: Consolidation successfully commenced in Q4 FY26 as reported in the May 2026 transcript.
promises.reasoning: The consolidation timeline was met exactly as promised.

promises.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.
promises.promised: Management set a target of 40 new Tanishq store openings for FY26.
promises.actual_delivered: Annual sales grew 71% in FY26 (from 51,084 Cr to 87,584 Cr), supported by aggressive expansion, though the specific final store count was not explicitly detailed in the text.
promises.reasoning: While growth was superlative, the transcript mentions execution delays in H1, and the final count is not confirmed in the provided text.

guidance.quote: we are committed to -- I'm just reiterating, we are committed to a double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business.
more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.

guidance.target: Positive EBIT performance for the full year
guidance.quote: I would expect overall portfolio would still turn out to be positive EBIT performance for the full year.
normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.
their normal trajectory should be towards 10%.

bull.point: Titan is successfully gaining market share in the fragmented jewellery industry.
bull.quote: Our sense is that perhaps we have gained about 50 to 60 bps is our sense on FY26 versus FY25.

bull.point: The company delivered massive annual revenue growth in FY26.

bear.point: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East is severely impacting Damas' performance.
bear.quote: given the current situation of war, I think purchasing jewellery in Dubai and Saudi and other countries is the last priority for anyone there.

bear.point: High gold prices are driving a shift toward lower-margin gold coins.
bear.quote: One is, of course, gold coin salience has gone up quite a bit.
